credit.credit-words: My Soul, Be on Thy Guard
WORDS: George Heath, pub.1781. MUSIC: “Laban”; Lowell Mason, 1830. Public Domain.

Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour. 1 Pet. 5:8 Be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might. Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand. Eph. 6:10-11
